title: Opened in 2005, Lucas’ 850,000-sq-ft San Francisco campus spans 23 acres, with 4 buildings
summary_full: In the heart of San Francisco, the former military hospital site has been ingeniously repurposed into the Letterman Digital Arts Center. This vibrant digital arts hub, established by George Lucas in 2005 post-demolition, now serves as a creative haven for Lucasfilm and other innovative firms. Careful attention to open spaces fosters community interaction and leisure, showcasing a successful model for urban redevelopment and creative collaborations.
